AnswerSnapshot.description: The streamed prose settled (ADR-0066): it REPLACES text, citations and masthead; cards are untouched.

answer_meta.description: Absent: the re-gate dropped the masthead.
answer_meta.title: Answer Meta

AnswerSnapshot.title: AnswerSnapshot

Attach.description: After a reconnect or a reload: replay this turn from ``after_seq`` + 1, then continue live.
Attach.title: Attach

CancelTurn.description: Stop. Authorised: only the asker (or an internal caller) may cancel a turn.
CancelTurn.title: CancelTurn

index.description: Position in the terminal's order: `[[card:N]]` is index N-1.
index.title: Index

ClarificationStep.description: The clarify step started: the one row it contributes before its first question.
ClarificationStep.title: ClarificationStep

InteractionRequestValue.description: The turn is waiting for its asker (``prompt_user_input``): a question, maybe with choices.

expires_at.description: Epoch ms; after it the turn ends with RUN_ERROR interaction_expired.
expires_at.title: Expires At

InteractionRequestValue.title: InteractionRequestValue

InteractionResponse.description: The asker's answer to an ``interaction_request``: typed text or a chosen option, never both.
InteractionResponse.title: InteractionResponse

KeyedCard.description: A card and its identity key, so a card equal to one already drawn keeps its node.

card.description: A GridCard (cards/models.py); validated by gridCardSchema on render.
card.title: Card

key.description: card_key(card): stable across the live event and the terminal.
key.title: Key

KeyedCard.title: KeyedCard

OptionAnswer.description: A chosen option, by the id the ``interaction_request`` gave it.
OptionAnswer.title: OptionAnswer

RejectedValue.description: A client message was refused. Out of band: ``seq == 0``, never replayed, never ends a turn.
RejectedValue.title: RejectedValue

RetrievalStep.description: One announced retrieval round: where it looks, for what, and the model's own conclusion.
RetrievalStep.title: RetrievalStep

RunHandoff.description: The run a turn commissioned (ADR-0062) and the message it narrates itself in: both or neither.
RunHandoff.title: RunHandoff

message_id.description: The answer's id; the bubble is keyed by it from now on.
message_id.title: Message Id

SkillStep.description: A skill was offered (count only), activated or loaded (``skills/events.py``).

count.description: `offered`: how many skills the catalog held.
count.title: Count

SkillStep.title: SkillStep

SourcesStep.description: What one evidence tool returned, as lanes. Built from the grounding records, never from text.
SourcesStep.title: SourcesStep

StatusStep.description: A status line or a technical record (``turn_status.emit_status`` and its siblings).

detail.description: Structured detail that is not part of the sentence (counts, reasons).
detail.title: Detail

key.description: i18n id (ALL_STATUS_KEYS); absent on technical records.
key.title: Key

StatusStep.title: StatusStep

TextAnswer.description: A typed answer. "skip" is only ever typed.
TextAnswer.title: TextAnswer

ToolStep.description: A tool call ran: its basename and outcome. Never its arguments or its result.
ToolStep.title: ToolStep

TraceLane.description: One lane of a search's fan-out: the fine lane and the coarse kind it renders as.
TraceLane.title: TraceLane

TraceLaneSource.description: One document in a lane: identity, the locus that round reached, its shelf.

name.description: Raw file name: the document identity.
name.title: Name

round.description: The retrieval round that fetched it.
round.title: Round

title.description: Display title, omitted when it would repeat `name`.
title.title: Title

TraceLaneSource.title: TraceLaneSource

TurnResult.description:
Everything the finished turn delivers; authoritative, and what the server persists.

It replaces the text once more and takes back what it omits (a card
suppressed, a masthead gated out). The persisted row is built from this
model and nothing else (``aiq_api`` ``persist_turn_result``).
TurnResult.title: TurnResult

UserMessage.description:
A question (or, with ``context_only``, a colleague's line the agent must see but not answer).

``type`` stays ``user_message``: the gateway's per-socket turn limiter
(``frontends/ui/src/lib/limits/ws-frames.js``) counts turns by it.
UserMessage.title: UserMessage

WireSource.description: A cited source (``source_entry_to_wire``). ``number`` is its ``[N]`` in the prose.
WireSource.title: WireSource
